kahvent.title: Kahvent
kahvent.summary: Wedding invitations on paper get lost and can't be checked at the door. In Kahvent, each guest's link is both their invitation and their QR entry pass.
kahvent.headline: Kahvent: one link that is the invitation and the entry pass
kahvent.platforms: Android and web from one Flutter codebase
kahvent.security: Row-level security on every table, hashed link tokens

problem.first: Wedding hosts in Lubumbashi still print invitation cards. Cards get lost, guests forward photos of them, and the door team has no way to know who is really invited or how many seats a family was given.
problem.second: I wanted one thing a host can send by WhatsApp that also works at the door.

features.f1_body: Each guest party gets one link. It shows the invitation and turns into a QR code at the door.
features.f2_body: Hosts invite helpers by team code. Each role sees only what it needs.
features.f3_body: Seats are given per party, so a family of five uses one pass.
features.f4_body: Hosts paste the guest list they already have instead of typing it again.

arch.client: Guest page · host dashboard · staff screens lazy-loaded
arch.backend: Auth · PostgreSQL with RLS and column grants

decisions.d1_body: Row-level security and column-level grants on every table, in versioned migrations. No permission depends on app code.
decisions.d2_title: Link tokens stored only as hashes
decisions.d2_body: A guest's link is their entry pass, so a database leak must not expose working links.
decisions.d3_body: Android and web from one Flutter app. Guests download only the guest page; staff-only screens load on demand.

kahvent.shot_card: Kahvent dashboard showing upcoming events and guest counts
kahvent.shot_hero: Kahvent event overview with guest parties, RSVP status and seat counts

tahadhari.title: Tahadhari
tahadhari.summary: Emergency alert app. A user raises an alert, their location and next of kin are notified by push in real time. Face verification at sign-up with AWS Rekognition.
tahadhari.headline: Tahadhari: real-time emergency alerts with verified users
tahadhari.role: Flutter developer in the Akrotech team

problem.first: In an emergency, an alert is only useful if it arrives at once, shows where the person is, and comes from a real user.
problem.second: Tahadhari broadcasts real-time alerts with live location, in English and French, and checks every new account with a face match.

features.f1_body: The alert carries the user's live location, shown on a map.
features.f2_body: Firebase Cloud Messaging delivers alerts in real time.
features.f3_body: AWS Rekognition must match the user's face with at least 90% confidence.
features.f4_body: The whole app and its alerts are localized with Flutter.

arch.client: Alert button · live map · EN / FR
arch.state: REST layer with structured error and offline handling
arch.backend: Firebase Cloud Messaging for real-time alerts

decisions.d1_body: Only authentic profiles can register: AWS Rekognition must report at least 90% confidence.
decisions.d2_body: Riverpod state and a REST layer with structured error and offline handling keep the app predictable.
decisions.d3_body: GitHub Actions and Codemagic cut the release pipeline from 15 minutes to under 2.

tahadhari.shot_card: Tahadhari map screen showing an active alert location
tahadhari.shot_hero: Tahadhari map screen showing an active alert location

rosary.title: Rosary
rosary.summary: Prayer tracker that shows the right mysteries for each day. Firebase sync with offline support, monetised with AdMob.
rosary.headline: Rosary: a prayer tracker that works fully offline
rosary.role: Flutter developer in the Akrotech team

problem.first: People pray where the connection is weak or absent, so a prayer app has to work without a network.
problem.second: Rosary shows the right content for each day, works fully offline and syncs in real time when the network comes back.

features.f1_body: The app shows the right mysteries for the day of the week.
features.f2_body: Content is cached on the device, so the app works with no signal.
features.f3_body: Firestore syncs the user's progress across devices.

decisions.d1_body: The device cache is the source the UI reads from; Firestore syncs in the background.
decisions.d2_body: Day-based liturgical content is picked on the device, so it works offline too.
decisions.d3_title: Ads that stay out of the way
decisions.d3_body: AdMob placements are non-intrusive, so prayer comes first.

clima.title: Clima
clima.summary: Weather app that shows the current weather for the user's location.
clima.headline: Clima: current weather for where you are

problem.first: A learning project from the Flutter bootcamp: call a real API, use device location and handle async data.
problem.second: Clima reads the phone's location and shows the current weather from OpenWeatherMap.

features.f1_body: Uses geolocation to find the user's city.
features.f2_body: Fetches current conditions from the OpenWeatherMap API.
